column1: # Census table for pypi — names the guard's typosquat lane flags (block or warn tier) that the registry shows are long-standing and heavily used.
# GENERATED by core/tools/established-table-gen — do not hand-edit; regenerate with:
#   go run ./tools/established-table-gen -ecosystem pypi -cache <dir outside the repo> -out cli/seeds/established_pypi.tsv
# Universe: the registry's full public name list (920141 names); the guard's detector flags 52280 of them (medium or high). No customer data.
# Admission (both): first published >= 2 years before 2026-10-22 AND >= 100000 downloads/week (pypistats.org last_week).
# Never admitted: known-malicious feed names (the `chainsaw guard update` OSV set + embedded floor), npm security placeholders, names without registry data.
# Columns: name <TAB> weekly_downloads <TAB> version_count <TAB> first_published <TAB> last_published <TAB> releases (comma-separated, build-time).
